idea-plugin.name: Maven Central MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Find the right Maven dependencies faster, with less AI context overhead.

Runs a local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server inside the IDE, giving AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code direct access to Maven Central. Search libraries, inspect dependency metadata and discover versions without lengthy web searches or browsing POM files.

Features

  • Artifact search – find libraries by artifact name, group ID or description keywords
  • Feature-based discovery – search by functionality, such as speech recognition or database migration
  • Dependency metadata – descriptions, licenses, developers, SCM information and more
  • Version discovery – latest stable and latest published versions, kept separate
  • Version history – versions, prereleases, platform variants and publication dates
  • Transparent results – ranking signals, data provenance and search-index limitations

MCP tools

  • search_artifacts – search Maven Central artifacts
  • get_artifact_info – retrieve artifact metadata
  • get_latest_version – find the latest stable and published versions
  • get_versions – list available versions

Getting started

Point your MCP client at the Streamable HTTP endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9909/mcp. The port is configurable in Settings | Tools | Maven Central MCP, and Tools | Maven Central MCP | Copy Client Configuration copies a ready-made snippet. The server runs only while the IDE is running.

Security and privacy

  • Local only – listens on 127.0.0.1, never on a LAN or public interface
  • Read-only – never reads or modifies your project files
  • Public data only – retrieves publicly available Maven Central information
  • No accounts, credentials or telemetry

Tested with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1–2026.2. Open source under the Apache License 2.0; source code, documentation and issues on GitHub.
